headline: Gulf Energy schedules road transit from Kenya oilfields to Mombasa port for December
summary: Gulf Energy confirmed its first-phase oil production schedule remains on track in Kenya. Road transportation of crude output to the port of Mombasa is set to begin on December 1.
why: Kenya's transition to crude oil exporting represents a structural shift for East African energy logistics and foreign exchange generation.

impacts.name: Gulf Energy
impacts.why: Gulf Energy's first-phase commercial oil production schedule remains on target.
